richiami.difetto: The A-pillar trim may become detached. When the side airbags deploy in case of an accident, they could strike the occupants and cause injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The A-pillar trim may become detached.

traduzione.difetto: Il rivestimento della colonna A potrebbe staccarsi. In caso di incidente, quando gli airbag laterali si attivano, potrebbero colpire gli occupanti e causare lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Il rivestimento della colonna A potrebbe staccarsi.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles under certain conditions the dry wipe logic built into the windscreen wiper motor can enter a fault state where the system speed cannot be increased to stalk position 3 or high speed.
richiami.rimedio: Replacement of the windscreen wiper motor assembly.
richiami.titolo: On affected vehicles under certain conditions the dry wipe logic built into the windscreen wiper motor can enter a fault state where the system speed cannot be increased to stalk position 3 or high speed.

richiami.difetto: The interior a-pillar trim tether has not been fitted onto certain production vehicles and therefore does not conform with the original Type Approval of the vehicle.  There is a risk the interior a-pillar trim may become completely detached upon deployment of the side curtain airbag potentially causing injury to the occupiers of the cabin.
richiami.rimedio: Fitment of the interior a-pillar trim tethers.
richiami.titolo: The interior a-pillar trim tether has not been fitted onto certain production vehicles and therefore does not conform with the original Type Approval of the vehicle.  There is a risk the interior a-pillar trim may become completely detached upon deployment of the side curtain airbag potentially causing injury to the occupiers of the cabin.

richiami.difetto: Bolts securing the fuel rail to the cylinder head may fail.
richiami.rimedio: The spacers and fuel rail securing bolts will be replaced with new revised parts
richiami.titolo: BOLTS SECURING THE FUEL RAIL TO THE CYCLINDER HEAD MAY FAIL.

richiami.difetto: The plastic spacers between the engine fuel rail and cylinder head may expand and contract. Consequently, the cylinder head's securing bolts might suffer excessive fatigue, leading to fuel leak, increasing the risk of accident and fire.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 03/12/2019
richiami.titolo: The plastic spacers between the engine fuel rail and cylinder head may expand and contract.

richiami.difetto: Assembly error involving the steering column that may affect crash behaviour.
richiami.rimedio: Ensure that the steering column is assembled correctly in accordance with the manufacturers� instructions.
richiami.titolo: STEERING COLUMN CARTRIDGE SCREW REQUIRES TIGHTENING

richiami.difetto: The cartridge that enables the partial collapse of the steering column in a crash might not work as expected due to an incorrectly tightened screw. This could increase the risk of injuries to vehicle occupants in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The cartridge that enables the partial collapse of the steering column in a crash might not work as expected due to an incorrectly tightened screw.

richiami.rimedio: Replace the brake master cylinder on affected vehicles.
richiami.titolo: REDUCTION OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY

richiami.difetto: The oil cooler pipes may detach from their fittings and deposit oil in the engine compartment on the road/tyres which can lead to increased risk of fire and loss of vehicle control. Only the pipes with the smooth bore ferrules are affected.
richiami.rimedio: Elise Exige and 211: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and repair or replace the oil cooler hoses.  Evora: it is proposed that the oil cooler hose assemblies will be replaced with hoses that incorporate the current production released end fittings in accordance with Lotus workshop procedures.

richiami.difetto: An oil cooler pipe may have insufficient room to move freely. As a result the pipe will abrade. If the concern remains unnoticed oil can leak in the engine bay with an increased risk of fire. Additionally oil can leak onto the road and cause a loss of control to the subject vehicle and other road users. If the driver does not heed the low oil pressure warnings then engine damage could occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the oil cooler pipes with a modified oil cooler pipe kit.
richiami.titolo: OIL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: It has been determined that under extreme circumstances the rubber hose section of the VVT oil pipe can leak.  A failure of the VVT oil feed pipe may result in oil being deposited onto the engine as well as the exhaust system. This could cause potential engine failure and a potential risk of fire because of the presence of flammable vapour  which could result in a crash.
richiami.rimedio: The oil feed pipe will be replaced
richiami.titolo: FIRE MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: The bolts securing the rear wheel hubs to the suspension may not have been correctly tightened.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check bolts for correct torque and if necessary remove and re-install bolts.
richiami.titolo: WHEEL HUB MAY BECOME INSECURE

richiami.difetto: It has been found that there is a small risk that the gear lever may break if subjected to high handling force.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and where necessary replace the gear lever and associated parts.
richiami.titolo: GEAR LEVER MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: It has been found that there is a small risk that the gear lever may break if subjected to high handling force.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and where necessary replace the gear lever and associated parts.
richiami.titolo: GEAR LEVER MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: There is a slight chance that one or more of the tapped holes for the four bolts securing the two halves of the brake caliper body together has not been threaded through the full depth of the hole.  The structural integrity of any such caliper may be compromised with the risk of fatigue failure of the caliper occurring after an extended period.
richiami.rimedio: Check the caliper tapped holes.  If any incomplete threading is found the brake caliper is to be replaced.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE CALIPER BOLTS CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Brake pipe routed along by battery on right hand drive models with air conditioning may rub into battery causing an acid spill.  This could result in damage to the brake pipe and a loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Examine the brake pipe and battery casing for damage and reposition brake pipe.  Renew brake pipe and/or battery if necessary.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PIPE CHAFING

richiami.difetto: In the event of a severe engine misfire the catalytic convertor could overheat which may subsequently result in a fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Reprogramme the ECU to incorporate a misfire detection system which will take remedial action in the event of a severe misfire.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MANAGEMENT

richiami.difetto: In the event of a severe engine misfire the catalytic convertor could overheat which may subsequently result in a fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Reprogramme the ECU to incorporate a misfire detection system which will take remedial action in the event of a severe misfire.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MANAGEMENT

richiami.difetto: A batch of steering rack assemblies has been identified as having been built with rack bars which have been subjected to an incorrect heat treatment rendering them susceptible to premature wear and possible tooth damage.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for a check of the steering rack assembly batch number. If this is confirmed as within the suspect batch the steering rack assembly is to be renewed.
richiami.titolo: STEERING RACK MAY BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO PREMATURE WEAR AND POSSIBLE TOOTH DAMAGE.

richiami.difetto: The hose connecting a spigot on the filler neck to the fuel tank top surface has been found to be of an incorrect material specification. The suspect hoses have a reduced resistance to tearing and rupturing forces exacerbated by careless or incorrect fitting.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace fuel filler breather hose with modified type.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK WHEN FILLING AND CORNERING

richiami.difetto: The hose connecting a spigot on the filler neck to the fuel tank top surface has been found to be of an incorrect material specification. The suspect hoses have a reduced resistance to tearing and rupturing forces exacerbated by careless or incorrect fitting.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace fuel filler breather hose with modified type.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK WHEN FILLING AND CORNERING

richiami.difetto: The fuel line push fit connectors may not be to the manufacturers specification. In consequence it is possible that fuel leakage may occur and initiate an engine bay fire.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the original fuel line connectors with quality assured versions.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAKAGE

richiami.difetto: Rear suspension toe link to hub carrier securing bolt may become loose and cause unstable handling.
richiami.rimedio: Remove and examine the subject securing bolt renew bolt where found necessary ensure that threads are clean apply approved locking compound refit and tighten bolt to the specified torque.
richiami.titolo: REAR SUSPENSION TOE LINK BOLT MAY BECOME LOOSE
